page.layout: One printed page, numbered 497. Running head at top. Below it a line of running heads (left: Num. Præceptor.; right: Cap. VI.). Main text in one column of numbered precepts. Marginal labels and references in the left margin and small references at the right edge of each line. Gathering signature "Ii" at foot left of the last line.

main_text.p: Observ.599 Mulieris manus amputabitur ib. φ quæ defensura virum suum apprehendit pudenda alterius, nec excusabit illam quod liberaret virum.
N.obs.600 Non habebis misericordiam ib. 12 supra illum qui aliquid male facturus est, sed in ipsa via ad malum interficies illum.
Observ.601 Pondus & Epha sint tibi justa. ib. 14
Observ.602 Recordaberis semper quod ib. 17 fecit tibi Amalechita.
Non obs.603 Exscindes semen Amalechi- ib. ult. tarum & delebis ipsorum memoriam.
Non obs.604 Diligenter recordaberis ne ib. 19 aliquando oblivisci quod Amalech tibi fecit.
N.obs.605 Debes profiteri Jehovæ supra 26. 5 primitias fructus tui.
N.obs.606 Debes etiam profiteri Jeho- 26. 12 væ supra decimas.
N.obs.607 Non comedes in luctu deci- ib. 14 mam secundam.
Non obs.608 Nec pollutas contaminatas- ib. 14 ve edes decimas dum redimantur pecuniis.

page.notes: The marginal labels are abbreviated and partly uncertain (e.g. "Observ.", "N.obs.", "Non obs."); the small references at the right edge are read from a faded scan. The left-margin label beside 603 and 604 is read as "Non obs." with some doubt. The line "Num. Præceptor. Cap. VI." is a secondary running line and is given in main text. The final line "609 Pe-" is a broken word continuing on the next page.
